changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 2a, item 1: updated to the tightened dreamux-types context contract (ChannelSessionCreateContext.logger/.state_root/.cache_root now required); deleted the now-dead console-fallback logger in provider.ts and collapsed the adjacent state_root guard into a single falsy check covering both the missing and empty-string cases. Internal-only; no runtime or published-API change.
